name: Talking About Something in the Nowhere
source:
Get to know your brand new self-aware in-game boyfriend and explore your relationship through Talking About Something in the Nowhere.

A short visual novel about romance and tragedy, we get to meet H, your alleged significant other. Help him around in your room while uncovering the secrets of your past together, from organizing books to finding clues hidden away in parts of the programming.

[From [url=https://rhoddonbyte.itch.io/talking-about-something-in-the-nowhere]itch.io[/url]]
